topic: Exact reciprocal-product thresholds, complementary jump sequences and integer-target cubic inversion
title: Oudra's cubic and quadratic floor conjectures and an alternative proof of Wu's tetrahedral formula

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove Ridouane Oudra's cubic floor conjecture, posed on October 6, 2023 in the FORMULA field of OEIS A248186, revision 18, and give an alternative proof of the tetrahedral counting formula contributed by Chai Wah Wu to A056556 on November 4, 2024 and treated in his 2025 article, Section 4, p.22. The least positive index k for which 1/18-sum_{h=1}^k 1/[h(h+1)(h+2)(h+3)]<n^(-3) is floor(r*n+r^2/n-1) for n>2, where r=3^(-1/3). An integer-target cubic inversion also recovers Oudra's earlier tetrahedral formula. A congruence argument proves his quadratic conjecture in A248183. For both threshold sequences we obtain exact jump positions and complementary densities, and for the cubic jumps we characterize their deviations from the associated Beatty sequence.
summary: Complete written proofs cover the two threshold conjectures, general integer-target inversion, both families of jump positions and densities, and an exact cubic Beatty-discrepancy criterion. Earlier tetrahedral formulas are reproved with attribution. The pinned Lean declaration covers sequence existence and the cubic conjecture. Exact finite checks accompany the note.
